data.long_meaning: Derived from the Turkic word 'ay' meaning 'goat' and the suffix '-la' meaning 'mountain'. The name Ayla carries the meaning “Mountain goat” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ayla usually hope their child will grow to embody mountain goat and live with faith, good character and purpose.
